description: [provider] Resolve a company name to its domain (free autocomplete). Returns a list of companies matching the given partial domain name — up to 10 companies per request (CompanyEnrich · Company data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: FREE, so this is the correct way to turn a fuzzy company name into a canonical domain BEFORE spending a credit on enrichment. Returns {domain, name, logoUrl} only.
